about_the_role: Northgate Labs builds internal tools for manufacturing clients. Small team, wide scope: you will touch the database, the API and the interface in the same week.
responsibilities: Build full features across a MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js stack.
Design REST API contracts and implement both sides of them.
Implement authentication, authorisation and audit logging.
Write integration tests covering the API surface.
Containerise services with Docker and support the deployment pipeline.
Review teammates' pull requests across both frontend and backend code.
required_skills: Strong JavaScript and Node.js for server-side development.
React for building application interfaces with component state.
Experience with Express.js and designing REST APIs.
Database experience with MongoDB, plus SQL fundamentals for relational work.
HTML and CSS sufficient to implement a given design accurately.
Git based workflow with meaningful commits and code review.
preferred_skills: Experience with PostgreSQL alongside document databases.
Authentication with JWT and third-party OAuth providers.
Docker and CI/CD experience for automated deployment.
Automated Testing with Jest or an equivalent framework.
Awareness of Web Security basics such as input validation and XSS prevention.
qualifications: Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent professional experience.
A deployed full-stack application you built and maintained.
